scripts.dist: mkdir -p dist && rm -rf dist/* && cp src/* dist/ -r
scripts.css:hash-replace: find dist -name '*.html' -type f -exec sed -i "s/index-page.css/index-page-$(sha1sum dist/_internal/index-page.css | awk '{print substr($1,0,7)}').css/" {} \;
scripts.css:hash-rename: mv dist/_internal/index-page.css dist/_internal/index-page-$(sha1sum dist/_internal/index-page.css | awk '{print substr($1,0,7)}').css
scripts.build: npm run dist && npm run css:postcss && npm run css:hash-replace && npm run css:hash-rename
